Denis Isbister and Jarod Higginbotham explore the rugged waters near Sandspit in search of giant lingcod.

title: Gone Again With Carter Andrews
description:
S01 E08 — Gone to Treasure Coast, Florida
Carter Andrews hosts the annual Lefty Cray's Tiefest, and targets bass in Florida and jacks on the coast.

title: Hooked on Africa Best of
description:
S02 E20 — Heritage Hunter
The team heads into the protected waters of South Africa's First World Heritage Site, the St Lucia Wetland Park. We learn about the major importance of this estuary to South Africa's fishery and hunt down the predators that call this park home.

title: Hooked on Travel
description:
S01 E20 — The Banks
There's only one way to really cover a large section of the Indian Ocean and that's in the comforts of a live-aboard yacht; Tommo sails to Northern Mozambique, looking for new coral reefs and any nervous water that would provide entertainment.
